resources.string: On a computer where you are already logged in to Instagram, open DevTools (F12) → Application → Cookies → https://www.instagram.com, and copy the value of the sessionid cookie. Paste it below.\n\nNo password is entered here. Reusing an existing session avoids the new-device login check.
